_readme: meals: { "<signature>": { file, w, h, focal: [x 0..1, y 0..1], table: 0..1, caption, dates: [YYYY-MM-DD...], id, source, sha256, prompt } }. signature as in image-plan.json (built from the PRINTED names, so display-name edits never change it). file is relative to the board asset folder GRVTV-Assets/menu/ (1024x1024 sRGB JPEG q86, written by GRVTV-2/tools/cafe-menu/stage-meal-image.py). focal = the dish the crop and slow push centre on; table = where clean table begins in front of the plate (caption zone, bottom left), kept inside every crop so the caption never sits on food. APPROVED illustrations only. A meal with no entry (or a file that fails to load) shows the plain layout, never a similar photo.
caption: AI-generated meal illustration.
